subject: E-6229: TLS handshake failed on macOS
body:
Regards, Grace Okafor, Meridian Schools

Before writing in I tried restarting the machine; same error
afterwards.

We never upgraded this machine; the OS release is years old.
The vendor's website says that release left support last
year.

Hello support team. We run Tallyboard 1.9.6 on macOS 14.7.
Whenever I open the app since yesterday, the app shows
'E-6229: TLS handshake failed'.
